input.subject: chore: add Entire Brain agent guide and pre-edit hook
input.body: Add .entire/agent-guide.md and point CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md at it so agents use Brain for task context and retained knowledge. Register a Brain pre-edit hook in .claude/settings.json. Entire's settings rewrite also reorders keys and escapes shell characters in the existing hooks.
